messages:
Maya Patel: @channel FYI — ACME says promo code SPRINT50 is misbehaving. Some accounts got 0 credits applied, others were allowed to redeem multiple times. They hit our frontend and our API returned 200 for apply calls. Can someone triage?

Leo Santos: Thanks Maya — can you paste the campaign id and a couple of affected customer IDs?

Maya Patel: Campaign id: cmp_82b1f. Example customers: acct_993 (0 credits), acct_1012 (redeemed twice). Customer says they applied via web on 2026-04-30.

Samir (support-bot): Auto-diagnostics for cmp_82b1f: status=ACTIVE, start_at=2026-05-01T00:00:00Z, end_at=2026-06-01T00:00:00Z, redemption_limit=0, per_customer_limit=null, scope=CAMPAIGN

Olivia Chen: Hmm redemption_limit=0 looks suspicious — that would block global redemptions. But why did some users get multiple redemptions? per_customer_limit=null could be interpreted as unlimited for some code paths.

Leo Santos: Repro steps I'm running: POST /v1/promos/apply {"code":"SPRINT50","account_id":"acct_993"} -> returns 200 {"applied":false,"reason":"redemption_limit_reached"}. Logs show apply flow returned success for UI because frontend only checks HTTP 200 not applied flag.

Maya Patel: That matches ACME's note — UI showed success modal but no credits were added for some users. They also reported two users getting two grants each.

Samir (support-bot): Pulling last 50 apply events for cmp_82b1f: -> some events show server-side grant skipped (reason=limit_zero), others show grant created but with duplicate request_id and identical timestamps -> suggests race when per_customer_limit unset.

Olivia Chen: Possible root cause: campaign created with redemption_limit=0 (accidental default), and per_customer_limit left null. Newer apply code path checks global redemption_limit and cancels, but older/edge path ignored it and allowed writes, producing inconsistent state under concurrent requests. Also start_at is 05-01 while ACME applied on 04-30 — that explains 0 credits for others due to start date in future and UI not surfacing 'not active yet'.

Leo Santos: Agreed. Fix plan: 1) Set redemption_limit to a positive integer (1000) so global blocking not triggered. 2) Set per_customer_limit=1 to enforce single use. 3) Patch front-end to surface applied=false message when API returns applied=false. 4) Identify affected accounts and restore credits.

Maya Patel: Can we patch campaign config now? Customer is waiting.

Olivia Chen: I'll patch via internal API. Command: 
```
PATCH /internal/v1/campaigns/cmp_82b1f
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "redemption_limit": 1000,
  "per_customer_limit": 1,
  "start_at": "2026-04-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

Samir (support-bot): Patch accepted (job job_773). Migration will reconcile counters. Note: reconciliation may mark some duplicate grants as duplicate and skip restoring if already granted.

Leo Santos: I'll run a query to find accounts with failed_applies on cmp_82b1f between 2026-04-29 and 2026-05-02 to compute restoration list.

Maya Patel: ACME asked for exact repro steps and timeline to give to their ops. I'll send them a short write-up once we have the root cause and list.

BillingBot: Detected affected accounts (n=12). Queued 120 trial credits to be restored to those accounts. Change-id: bill_556.

Olivia Chen: Quick follow-ups — I'll open a product bug for default redemption_limit validation and a frontend ticket to show explicit apply result. Also adding a data validation check preventing start_at in the future without explicit 'allow_prestart' flag.

Maya Patel: Thanks everyone. I'll update ACME and mark this escalated to priority-high. :white_check_mark: 

Samir (support-bot): Incident note: root cause = campaign created with redemption_limit=0 + inconsistent code paths + start_at in future causing mixed apply results. Remediation steps listed above.

BillingBot: Credits restored for listed accounts. Audit log: https://redwood.example/audit/bill_556

Olivia Chen: Leaving this thread with tasks assigned. Closing once customer confirms restores and frontend change deployed.

Maya Patel: Customer confirmed restores at 10:42 UTC. Closing. :tada:
